name: Cheesy Pork Sausage & Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Lettuce & Tomato
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.

To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide pork and bell pepper between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Top with cheese and fold in half to close. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, chop lettuce crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Transfer to another plate.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to plate with the lettuce.
To serve, cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates; top with lettuce and tomatoes. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
